evidence: The reactor was set to 130 oC, both metal precursors had a pulse time of 2 s, ROH had a pulse time of 25 ms, and water had a pulse time of 25 ms. A vapor-boosting 20 ms pulse of nitrogen was added to the BiPh 3 cylinder just prior to each pulse. The excess precursors were purged after each exposure using 200 sccm nitrogen for 10 s.
